This is a straightforward exploration/navigation task where the agent must locate a specific block in the environment. It is observable and verifiable (the agent needs to have the block within view or reach a position near it). Yellow glazed terracotta is a distinctive decorative block that is easy to visually identify, making verification clear. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, no multi-hop dependency chain is needed, but the task itself requires the agent to navigate the scene and identify the correct block among potentially other blocks or structures.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task — the player must navigate around the cobblestone structure (at spawn-relative ~3-7, 0, 4-8) to discover the hidden yellow glazed terracotta behind it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has genuinely navigated past the building (~13 blocks from spawn) rather than just turning to face it from the start. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the terracotta when nearby, modeling 'the player can see the target.'

scene_description: A flat grass field with multiple structures and colored glazed terracotta pillars. The target yellow glazed terracotta is hidden behind a large cobblestone structure, requiring the player to explore around buildings to find it. Distractor terracotta (red, blue, green) is placed in more visible locations to test color discrimination.
task_text: Find the yellow glazed terracotta blocks hidden somewhere in this area. Explore around all structures — the target may not be visible from your starting position.
design_notes: Yellow glazed terracotta is at (~5,0,12) and (~6,0,12), hidden behind the cobblestone structure at (~3-7, 0, 4-8). The cobblestone building is 5 wide, 4 tall, 5 deep with a hollow interior and doorway on the south side (facing spawn). The yellow terracotta is 4 blocks behind the north wall of the cobblestone building. A stone brick structure at (~-2,0,7) to (~0,2,9) adds additional visual occlusion. Distractor terracotta: red at (-10,0,5), blue at (12,0,-5), green at (-8,0,-10). The player must navigate around the cobblestone structure to discover the yellow terracotta.
